title: Sig_structure
description: Restates QR Code Generation, 6. Step 5 — Sign as a COSE_Sign1; RFC 8152 CBOR Object Signing and Encryption (COSE). QR Code Generation, 6. Step 5 — Sign as a COSE_Sign1: “serialise it as CBOR, and sign those bytes.”.

statements.label: Sig_structure
statements.requirement: The signature input SHALL be the CBOR encoding of ["Signature1", protected header bytes exactly as transmitted, empty external_aad, payload bytes]. The verifier SHALL use the received protected bytes and SHALL NOT re-encode the decoded header.
